emerging_technology: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with a large language model over internal authoritative documents
organization: Fictional mid-sized industrial manufacturer with SAP Ariba and Jira Service Management Cloud
intended_application: Employee self-service for routine purchase requisition policy and how-to questions with direct citations
business_need: Reduce time spent searching for current instructions and responding to repetitive questions
users_stakeholders: Requesters, procurement operations, policy owners and IT security
capabilities_constraints: Versioned policies and procurement help desk are available. SAP Ariba is installed. Joule entitlement, permissions, local policy coverage and cost are unverified. Procurement can build a bilingual evaluation set.
risk_consequence_context: Wrong answers could direct employees to the wrong approval path. Human policy owners retain authority for approvals and exceptions. Read-only pilot.
management_question: Should procurement evaluate RAG against curated policy search and a help desk, and when should it reconsider a platform-native option?
additional_context: Synthetic classroom scenario. VP of Procurement owns the pilot. Check English and Mandarin questions. Use evidence snapshot dated 2026-11-16.
